prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: [验证] 二维合并 · 采购评审 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 5 columns × 4 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Merged cells: "甲、乙两家报价接近，建议进入第二轮商务谈判，重点" spans 1 col × 2 row; "未按要求提交完整报价文件，视为无效投标" spans 3 col × 1 row.
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "供应商" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 46px
  col 2: header "报价" · longest unbreakable word 65px · one-line width 65px
  col 3: header "交期" · longest unbreakable word 19px · one-line width 38px
  col 4: header "质保" · longest unbreakable word 16px · one-line width 31px
  col 5: header "评审意见" · longest unbreakable word 31px · one-line width 582px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"比较供应商报价、交期和质保，并记录评审意见及无效投标结果。","reading":"读者先按行识别供应商，再横向比较报价、交期和质保；甲、乙共享的评审意见跨两行，丙的无效投标说明横跨三个指标列。","groups":["报价、交期、质保是并列的采购比较指标，应保持清晰的列间节奏。","供应商是行标识；评审意见是解释性文字，与数值指标的阅读方式不同。"],"keep_intact":["报价金额及货币符号，便于准确比较。","供应商名称、交期和质保值尽量保持完整，便于按行扫描。","跨行评审意见和跨列无效投标说明的合并关系。"],"may_wrap":["评审意见可按中文自然换行；其跨两行的高度可吸收部分换行。","无效投标说明可在横跨报价、交期和质保的单元格内自然换行。","空间紧张时，中文表头和供应商名称可以换行，但会降低扫描速度。"]}

Design r0B: widths [67, 86, 45, 40, 121] · table 360×319px · row heights [60, 88, 88, 83] · column headers wrapped 2/5 · tallest cell 7 lines · mid-word splits 0

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it).
